# .NET error codes

*Generated by `dotnet/scripts/reference.py` from Toskar Core's error catalog and the SDK's own codes.*

The codes Toskar Core and the SDK answer errors with, as `ToskarException.Code`, with each one's English text. Core's are constants on `ErrorCodes`; the SDK's own are for what goes wrong before Core answers. A newer Core may answer with a code this list doesn't have yet.

| Code | Text |
| --- | --- |
| `ErrorCodes.API_KEYS_LIST_FAILED` | {{detail}} |
| `ErrorCodes.API_KEY_IN_URL` | Send the API key in the Authorization header, not in the address. |
| `ErrorCodes.API_KEY_REQUIRED` | Create an API key or add a person before allowing access from other devices. |
| `ErrorCodes.APPROVE_FAILED` | {{detail}} |
| `ErrorCodes.ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND` | That attempt is gone. |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_FAILED` | {{detail}} |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_INTERRUPTED` | The run didn't finish because Toskar stopped while it ran. It runs again at its next time. |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_INVALID` | {{detail}} |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_NOT_WEBHOOK` | This automation doesn't run from a webhook. |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_NO_RESULT` | This run has no result to continue in chat. |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_PAUSED` | This automation is paused. |
| `ErrorCodes.AUTOMATION_RUNNING` | This automation is already running. Its result will appear here when it finishes. |

| `HTTP_<status>` (the SDK's own) | Toskar answered <status> with a body that isn't Toskar's |
| `NOT_CONFIRMED` (the SDK's own) | The short pin wasn't confirmed |
| `NO_RECORD` (the SDK's own) | No address record for the computer: it may be off or asleep, or have no access from anywhere |
| `PIN_MISMATCH` (the SDK's own) | The computer's certificate isn't the one paired with |
| `RECORD_PIN` (the SDK's own) | The record isn't from the pinned computer |
| `RECORD_SEALED` (the SDK's own) | The record doesn't open with this route secret |
| `RECORD_STALE` (the SDK's own) | The record is too old |
| `UNREACHABLE` (the SDK's own) | The computer can't be reached |
